title: A must-do tour! Easy bike riding while enjoying the city!
text:
This bike tour was awesome! Our tour guide and photographer, Luba, was superb! She was very knowledgeable and positive. She genuinely seemed to enjoy her job and she was just so positive and sincere with the bike group. She took us to all the attractions on the itinerary and gave us reasonable time at each location.  

This was pur first bike tour ever on our trip and we were left wondering what we have been missing on all our previous vacations.  5 out of 5 stars for Luba for making this a memorable experience! Oh, and by the wat, she took some awesome photos!  Highly recommend!
author: strucksylver

title: Superior tour
text: We stopped at many popular sites around the city. Martin has lived in Barcelona for 18 years, and he shared many details about the sites that only a local would know. This city is made for bike tours - very safe, lots of fun for the whole family. My girls said afterwards that they ALWAYS want to see new cities by bike.
author: bill_b

title: Don’t miss this tour
text: This is one of the best tours we did in our 6 week trip. Martin is a fabulous guide and incredibly knowledgeable about Barcelona. In 3.5 hours we cycled around the major highlights at a gentle pace that would suit all cyclists ability levels. What sets this tour apart from others is that Martin takes the most amazing professional photographs and knows the best spots to capture the beauty of Barcelona as a backdrop. We had a wonderful experience with the added benefit of a photo shoot. We now have the challenge of selecting which photos to print from the hundreds taken on the day. Perfect first
author: PEPPERPOTS99

title: Bikes, Pics, Memories for years!
text:
Holy heck, this was amazing. My wife and I love riding bikes in all of the cities we visit and this was checked ALL of our boxes. Not only were we able to see the whole city, safely and efficiently, but also we got some amazing photos!

Martin was an awesome host. If you're considering booking this, just click book. You won't regret it.
author: Nick B

title: Look no further, if you want an incredible Barcelona Bike Tour and Guide with Photos!
text: Absolutely loved this tour! We had a small group of 5 people and our guide Martin spoke great English and was super helpful and knowledgeable.  I appreciated his insight and recommendations to the top spots we visited on the tour and he took great photos for us.  Highly recommend this tour, it's a great one to do early in the trip so you can be oriented to the city.
author: WestSeattlit3

title: Best experience EVER!
text: Everything about this tour was fantastic and way above my expectations! The photos came out beautifully and are the best ones we have from our trip to Europe! We got to see some beautiful sights and our guide/photographer Martin was the best! He took us to food after the tour and picked out some amazing, unique dishes for us to try (great for both the foodies and the not-so-adventurous!). Our group was small, only 6 of us, so it was very personal and a great experience. You don’t need to be particularly athletic, there are no hills that I can remember. You will not regret booking this, I wish
author: Megan_E

title: The perfect tour to see Barcelona and take you the best photographs
text: The tour was perfect! Martin took us to unique places, we met much of the city and took amazing photos. Super recommended!
author: ceciliamT5949ZK

title: 100% recommended
text: The tour is perfect to know the city, I went to Barcelona for only two days and this tour helped me to explore the best of the city. 100% recommended. The pictures Martin takes with his camera are incredible.
author: V9095AQceciliam

title: Highly recommend this tour
text: Amazing tour and highly recommend! Very easy biking around a flat city with good bike lanes. Tour hits both the tourists hot spots and the hidden gems, plus great commentaries throughout. You get photos at the end of the tour while enjoying delicious tapas. One of the best bike tours I've ever taken
author: M7670ELnicolat

title: Best Barcelona Tour & Great Photos!
text: I went on 3 tours during my time in Barcelona, including 2 photo tours, but this was my favorite! I happened to be the only person on a Monday tour in November, but Martin was extremely courteous and informative. Bike riding around Barcelona is a great way to explore the city, and it gave me ideas of where to spend more time later on in my trip. I recommend to do the tour early on in your trip. I was able to get all the pictures before the end of the tour through AirDrop (he can also transfer them in other ways too), and they were the best photos of my trip!
author: gobears78
